notes.title: Version 1.2.3
notes.content:
Balance Changes
[list]
[*] Fire Punch now goes through terrain. Fire Punch Damage Decreased from 3 -> 2
[*] Dark Punch is now armored and will not be interrupted when taking less than 3 damage from a hit.
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue where players could clip into terrain in the library and get soft-locked
[*] Fixed certain dragon attacks going the wrong direction when facing left
[*] Fixed layering issues on certain enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 July 16th Update
notes.content:
Major Fix:
Some settings caused the game to launch in 16:9 resolutions. The game was designed to be in 4:3 and should properly open in the correct resolution.

Various minor bug fixes including:
[list]
[*] Fixed one screen transition in the forest stage not working properly
[*] Fixed the catacomb boss flags not properly resetting after dying
[*] Fixed certain lasers going behind certain terrains
[/list]

Fixed one screen transition in the forest stage not working properly
Fixed the catacomb boss flags not properly resetting after dying
Fixed certain lasers going behind certain terrains

notes.title: Update Notes For 4/9/2023
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed collision of bookshelves in library stage to help prevent clipping into unintended areas.
[*]Fixed incorrect flags being set in the Star Tower stage allowing certain pickups to be grabbed multiple times.
[*]Minor HP adjustments on bosses
[/list]
Along with these changes in the code I did not realize that the default Steam Controller profile was incorrect and has been changed to Generic Gamepad. Hopefully this addresses some of the controller issues I've seen.
